customer: Can Northwind buy out my cargo van lease? It's through Ironwood Lease.
agent: Unfortunately, Ironwood Lease doesn't allow third-party buyouts, so we can't buy out your lease directly. You could buy the van out yourself first and then sell it to us, or return it at the end of the lease. Our article "Selling vs. turning in at lease end" covers both options if you'd like to compare.
